wallpapers.title: Where history stands watch
wallpapers.caption: Kunětická hora Castle, Bohemia, Czechia
wallpapers.desc: What stories could these walls tell? Rising above eastern Bohemia in Czechia, Kunětická hora Castle has witnessed centuries of history. Dating to the late 14th century, the castle gradually evolved into an impressive fortress and noble residence. Its elevated position offered commanding views of the surrounding countryside and helped make it an important stronghold.
